title: MEIKO — Red Melody〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, how's the show so far?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I hope you'll enjoy the rest of the show too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As for now, I will sing my next song!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, look at that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is that TV over there playing the video you were showing me the other day?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
They may be showing MEIKO's live performance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, that felt pretty good!
Let's keep this momentum going for the next song too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: MEIKO is so cool.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Her red outfit is really nice, too.
Feels like something a truly mature woman would wear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I've never worn leather clothing like that before...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, I have one or two, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's not easy to pull off that sort of look successfully.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You guys still want more, right?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Her singing really draws you in...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm... Maybe we'll become like that too in another ten years?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? I think you could definitely become like that, but not me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why not? You never know, right?
Maybe you'll be even more like her than me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I would really rather have an older sister like her instead of becoming like that myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You would?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm, that's true. A cool-looking and dependable older sister would rock! Someone who comes wake me up every morning...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, wake you up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! With a calm and gentle voice like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, sunshine, it's already morning. Wakey-wakey.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll wash up, and she already have breakfast ready for me at the living room!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And then she says, Make sure to eat your lunch, and have a good day out there. Man, that'd be such a great start to my day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm surprised you like to be coddled like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? N-Not really.
I was just thinking if it was MEIKO, she'd totally do something like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, she seems so reliable and patient, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And, well, my mom isn't very good at cooking...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad leaves early to get ready for the shop. I just think it'd be nice to have someone make a nice meal for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-Stop laughing at me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Come on, everyone, let's sing together! Clap your hands!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's bring this house down!
